title: Unit normalization of the specified scalar direct-image comparison
statement: Let $g:Z\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $\varphi:A\to B$ a map of finite commutative rings. For the ordinary direct-image functors $F=g_*^B$, $H=g_*^A$, scalar restrictions $x=\operatorname{Res}_\varphi^Z$, $y=\operatorname{Res}_\varphi^Y$, and the ordinary identity-on-sections comparison $c:F;y\cong x;H$ [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars], the inverse of the specified comparison sfDerivedImageRestriction [def-sf-compact-support-restriction-data] is unitNormalized [lem-pur-derived-square-normalization-naturality]. Explicitly, for every cochain complex $I$, $Dy(\eta_F(I));\chi^{-1}_{QI};RH(x_{\mathrm{fac},I})=y_{\mathrm{fac},FI};Q(c_I);\eta_H(xI)$. No preservation of K-injectives by restriction is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0D6E and 0D6J; comparison of the right-derived unit equation with its K-injective resolution equation.

proof.text: Choose the all-complex unit-normalized coefficient comparison supplied by coefficientDerivedComparison_exists. On a K-injective B-complex J choose a K-injective replacement j of its A-restriction. Naturality of the target derived unit and the normalization equation express its inverse through the same localized direct-image replacement map as proEtaleDerivedDirectImage_restrictScalars. Cancel the latter quasi-isomorphism and the two localization isomorphisms to identify this inverse with sfDerivedImageRestriction on QJ. Naturality and K-injective representatives extend the equality to every derived object. Substitute it in the all-complex unit equation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0D6E and 0D6J; uniqueness of unit-normalized right derivation, verified through the specified K-injective resolution equation.

lean.statement:
theorem compactSupportScalarDirectNormalization
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y) (φ : A →+* B) :
    CategoryTheory.ExactDerivedSquare.unitNormalized.{u + 1, u + 2}
      (proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage g B) (proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage g A)
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Z φ) (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y φ)
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Z φ).mapDerivedCategory
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y φ).mapDerivedCategory
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Z φ).mapDerivedCategoryFactors
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y φ).mapDerivedCategoryFactors
      (proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageComparison g φ).hom
      (sfDerivedImageRestriction g φ).inv
